notes.title: 🕯️ Tenth Update of Delirium: Echoes of the Domino
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/d99a53de9f3e7616e6e7a8049942074559220286.png"]
🏰 New Mode: The Tower
Every ascent demands sacrifice. After each boss battle:

🔹 Lose one random Wild card.

🔹 Gain $10 as compensation.
A mode built for those who thrive on risk and adaptability.
[hr][/hr]💔 New Boss: Broken Mercy
A constant punishment that corrupts your progress. Each time you discard, a Cursed Domino (-1 | -1) is added to your bag, weakening your plays. Mercy is gone… only suffering remains.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ UI & Quality of Life Improvements
Visual adjustments for a clearer, more immersive interface.

Quality-of-life improvements to make every run smoother and more strategic.
[hr][/hr]
⚔️ With The Tower and Broken Mercy, the challenge reaches new heights.
Will you keep climbing without losing your balance?

notes.title: 🔥 Ninth Update: The Devil and the Unstable Flame
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/0373013c729f3cbc6fea6ef9415f8e5fd2c7c16c.png"]
🃏 New mode: The Devil
The deal is sealed. You start the game with an extra $10, but at a price: you won't be able to sell any dominoes for the entire run. A risky choice for those who want to try their luck.
[hr][/hr]🔥 New boss: The Unstable Flame
An unpredictable adversary that consumes everything in its path. Every time you place a token on the board, another token will be randomly destroyed in your bag. Can you maintain control amidst the chaos?
[hr][/hr]🛠️Quality and UI improvements
Visual tweaks to the interface for a clearer and smoother experience.

Quality of life improvements to streamline matches and make each run more satisfying.
[hr][/hr]
💀 With The Devil and the Unstable Flame, chance has never been so dangerous. Update the game, face the fire, and prove you can master chaos.

notes.title: 🌀 Update 8 – Temperance and The Preacher
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/692bd5eba234f4391af08f6ce3bbbfd8e8a3ced7.png"]
✨ New Game Mode: Temperance
A challenge of balance and patience:

You start with one less wild card space.

However, all double tiles are worth +50 points, becoming key pieces for your strategies!

Will you be able to maintain control and take advantage of this poisoned blessing?
[hr][/hr]👁️ New Boss: The Preacher
A ruthless figure who dictates strange rules on the board:

Even pieces don't score points.

Only odd pieces can lead you to victory.

Be prepared to change your way of playing: what seemed safe is now worthless.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Interface and quality of life improvements
Adjustments to wildcard display for clarity.

Balance fixes on higher difficulties.

Improvements to menus and visual feedback during matches.
[hr][/hr]🚪 Enter the madness
With each update, Delirium: Echoes of the Domino continues to grow thanks to your support and feedback. Can you master the duality of Temperance and overcome the Preacher's sermon?

👉 Play now in Early Access on Steam.

notes.title: ⚰️ Update 7 – The Death & The Eternal Miser
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/3f376e745d530fbacf7badad69dad074c05d1628.png"]
🕒 New Game Mode: The Death
In this mode, the clock becomes your greatest enemy.

All runs are played against a 15-minute timer.

Strategy and speed now go hand in hand — every discard, every placement, every decision counts.

Will you keep your cool under pressure, or will the ticking clock push you into chaos?
[hr][/hr]💰 New Boss: The Eternal Miser
A twisted collector of riches who despises generosity.

Golden dominoes now score 0 points.

What was once a blessing turns into a curse, forcing you to rethink your strategy.

Only the most resourceful players will adapt to this ruthless handicap.
[hr][/hr]🖥️ Interface & Quality-of-Life Updates
Alongside new content, we’ve also made improvements to make your experience smoother:

Refined UI for better readability.

Improved feedback on scoring and discards.

Several bug fixes and optimizations.
[hr][/hr]🌌 Keep Building the Delirium
With every update, the world of Delirium: Echoes of the Domino grows deeper and stranger.
Thank you for playing, sharing feedback, and helping shape the game during Early Access.

Your journey through the delirium continues…
And remember: time waits for no one.

notes.title: 🕹️ Update 6 – The Hanged One & The Broken Gear
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/40e31afbd1c77b4728c2c8b823106cd5a68d232a.jpg"]
✨ New Game Mode: The Hanged One
Begin your run with a random Global Upgrade.

Fortune or misfortune? Only fate will decide what power you start with.
[hr][/hr]☠️ New Boss: The Broken Gear
A twisted machine of rust and ruin.

Red dominoes now score 0 under its oppressive curse.

Adapt your strategy or watch your combos crumble.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ UI & Quality of Life Improvements
Enhanced user interface for smoother navigation.

Improved feedback and effects during gameplay.

General balance and performance adjustments to make each run feel even better.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback 🙌 Every update brings us closer to shaping Delirium into the best roguelike domino experience possible.

🔮 Will you endure the curse of the Broken Gear, or rise with the fate of the Hanged One?

notes.title: 💥 Update 4 & 5 – The Wheel of Fortune Spins, The Force, Herald of the Ruin, ...
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/019d7722c9ca23d4019d796ac30c4e35447d45fe.jpg"]
🎡 NEW GAME MODE: The Wheel of Fortune
In this mode, fate shines bright:
✨ 35% of your dominoes will be golden.
Gold means power, but it also means adapting your strategy to an unpredictable flow of tiles.
[hr][/hr]🃏 New Game Mode: The Force
Begin your run with a random Joker already in your hand. This mysterious gift could shape your entire strategy… but remember: you cannot sell it. Will it be your blessing, or your curse?
[hr][/hr]☠️ NEW BOSS: The Herald of Ruin
This merciless foe twists the rules of the game:
➖ Even-numbered dominoes subtract points instead of adding them.

Can you build your combos when half your arsenal betrays you?
[hr][/hr]☠️ New Boss: The Withered Echo
The battlefield fades as green tiles score 0 points under this cursed entity’s influence. Every move must be calculated carefully, or your strategy will wither away.
[hr][/hr]⚙️ Additional Changes
Balance adjustments to scoring in certain modes.

Visual polish and small bug fixes.

Preparations for future updates.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all for being part of this journey! Your feedback is shaping the chaos and strategy of Delirium: Echoes of the Domino.

🎲 The Wheel has spun. Will you rise with gold… or fall into ruin?

🃏 Play the new update now in Early Access!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/ccd24975f6db102d6691806ae87846e24ff4311a.jpg"]

notes.title: 🔥 Third Update: The Hermit and The Bank Have Arrived
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/81cabb31a7be250ab221b2a16dca1a88d9c8a4ae.png"]

Greetings from the Delirium!

We’re excited to announce the third major update for Delirium: Echoes of the Domino. This patch adds a new game mode and a new boss that will test your planning, adaptability, and luck in unexpected ways.
[hr][/hr]🌑 NEW GAME MODE: The Hermit
"Sometimes solitude whispers secrets of hidden power."

In this mode, things get a little unstable:
🟥 20% of your dominoes will be red, bringing unpredictable effects that could lead you to glory—or ruin.

A perfect pick for those who enjoy a more chaotic run.
[hr][/hr]🧮 NEW BOSS: The Bank
"The house always wins. Even here."

This time, your performance will be hit where it hurts most:
➗ All points and multipliers are halved when facing The Bank.

You'll need tight strategies, flawless execution, and just a bit of luck to survive this one.
[hr][/hr]⚙️ What's new in this update?
General economy and difficulty balancing.

Minor bug fixes.

Preparation for upcoming bosses and game modes.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for supporting Delirium: Echoes of the Domino. Every match and every piece of feedback help shape this game.

📥 Haven’t tried it yet?
Download the free demo or join Early Access today.

🃏 See you on the board!

notes.title: Second Update Released: Justice and the Loan Shark Join the Game!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/f0c9035115ceea2b7c7e4e54d58962894c0806ee.png"]
🃏 New Game Mode: Justice
Start your run with an entire set of green domino tiles, designed to bring balance… or break it spectacularly. Will you play fair or tilt the scale in your favor?

"When balance is imposed from the beginning, only the wise know how to bend the rules."
💰 New Boss: The Loan Shark
Every tile you play will cost you $2. This boss doesn’t play around — every move you make is a financial burden.

"Debt is his domain. Each move, another coin lost. Each hesitation, a missed opportunity."
[hr][/hr]
🎯 This demo now features 8 game modes, 6 difficulty levels, and 11 unique bosses.
Thank you for joining the Delirium — we’ll keep expanding and polishing the game with your feedback.

🃏 If you haven’t yet, add the game to your wishlist and share your wildest combos with us!

notes.title: First Update for Delirium - Introducing The Chariot and The Final Cry
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618005/7b93eea5ecf3027a7008bfd28fd8df154492dad9.png"]
🃏 New Game Mode: The Chariot
Inspired by the Major Arcana, The Chariot changes the pace right from the start. Your initial domino set is made entirely of even numbers.

This dramatically alters early-game strategy. No odd tiles means new synergies, new traps… and a new path to master.

Description:

Victory requires direction. The Chariot doesn’t move without control: every play, every decision, defines your destiny.
[hr][/hr]👹 New Boss: The Final Cry
A new threat emerges to twist your run into something unforgettable. The Final Cry brings a brutal mechanic to the board:
💥 High Stakes Wager — You’ll earn more… but only if you survive the risk.

Description:

A voice you can’t hear, but one that demands everything. Are you willing to risk it all for just a few more points?
[hr][/hr]✨ And this is just the beginning…
We’ll keep adding new game modes, bosses, global upgrades, and features to expand and refine Delirium. Thank you for playing, sharing your thoughts, and helping us shape this chaotic domino roguelike.

If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave a review — and join the community discussions to help us improve with every update.
[hr][/hr]
Welcome back to the Delirium.
– The Delirium: Echoes of the Domino Team
